reconstructed_theorem_text: For every w,z in a real inner-product space E and every differentiability order n ∈ WithTop ℕ∞, the curve t ↦ γ_{w,z}(t) is Cⁿ as a map ℝ → E.
objects: The unit-sphere geodesic curve γ_{w,z} and a differentiability order n.
domains: E is a real inner-product space, w,z ∈ E, and n ∈ WithTop ℕ∞.
quantifiers: For every w,z ∈ E and every n ∈ WithTop ℕ∞.
conclusion: γ_{w,z} : ℝ → E is n-times continuously differentiable.
scopes: Global regularity on ℝ, including the degenerate case z = 0.
constant_dependencies: No regularity constant is asserted; the result depends parametrically on w and z.
